# Warden

> A local policy layer for agent tool calls routed through supported Warden integrations.

Warden applies deterministic policy to routed calls. It supports native hooks/plugins where verified, a local MCP proxy for selected MCP tools, and a TypeScript authorization runtime. Decisions can be ALLOW, DENY, CONFIRM, or QUARANTINE and are recorded in a local hash-chained ledger.

## Important boundary

Warden does not govern native agent actions that bypass a supported integration. Check the current capability matrix before relying on an integration for enforcement.
